clause: Mixed page sizes/orientations + page & spread operations (typed commands + events) [STU-LAY-003]

scope.summary: Support mixed page trim sizes and orientations within one document: each page carries its own trim size, orientation, margins, bleed, slug, and liquid-layout rule independent of siblings (per-page geometry via a page-resize operation). Expose page/spread operations as typed commands that MUST emit studio.layout EventLedger events: insert, move, duplicate, delete, reorder-by-drag, hide/unhide from view and output, apply color labels, and a move/copy-pages dialog for precise placement. Backed by StudioPageSpread; command shape carries dry_run+receipt+undo per the command surface.
acceptance_criteria: per-page independent geometry; all page/spread ops as typed commands emitting studio.layout events; move/copy dialog
proof_targets: page-op command emits studio.layout event + undo; Argus navigator inspect
expected_tests: live: insert/move/duplicate/delete/reorder/hide/label each emit a studio.layout event + are undoable
argus: page navigator reflects mixed sizes/orientations after per-page resize

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Managing pages (mixed size, insert, move, hide, labels)

risk_if_missed: No page management; documents cannot be built, edited, or repaginated; edits unauditable.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
